title: Giving Back Part of a Correctly Charged Personal Checking Overdraft Charge
content:
Where a Personal Checking account has been correctly charged for items paid into overdraft, the bank may give part of that money back as a goodwill gesture, recorded against the most recently posted of the charges it covers.

Goodwill relief on overdraft charges is granted only once the account's record names an active savings account of the owner as the source the bank may draw on to cover items.

An account whose entries leave it at or above zero is outside this rule and no goodwill relief is granted.

The overdraft charges themselves stay on the record, the entry carries the goodwill ground rather than any bank-error ground, and the account's posted ledger balance rises by the amount given back.

## Recording the entry

The goodwill entry is booked with the tool `post_overdraft_courtesy_relief_64b96dbf`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. One call books a single goodwill entry credited to the named checking account and ties it to the overdraft charge it is granted against.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `checking_account_id` | The reference number of the Personal Checking account the goodwill credit is posted to, taken from the checking account lookup for this owner |
| `customer_id` | The reference number of the customer profile that owns the account, as returned by the customer profile lookup; it is stamped on the entry so the owner's goodwill record stays complete |
| `source_item_id` | The reference number of the single overdraft charge entry on the account that the goodwill entry is recorded against, read from the account's posted activity |
| `relief_amount` | The money given back as goodwill, in United States dollars to 2 decimal places, always positive and rounded half-up to the cent at the moment of the call; there is no empty value and zero is not accepted |
| `statement_cycle` | The statement cycle the goodwill entry belongs to, written as the year and month in which that cycle closes, with no day part and no time zone |

### Return

The call answers with a confirmation sentence carrying the reference number minted for the new goodwill entry, the amount given back to the cent, and the account's posted ledger balance after the credit. That sentence naming a goodwill entry reference number is what shows the call completed; the credit is then visible in the account's posted activity.
